# SELF

> SELF is a comprehensive women's health and wellness platform covering medical conditions, fitness, nutrition, mental health, and lifestyle content.

SELF provides evidence-based health information and practical wellness guidance specifically for women, featuring expert advice, video content, fitness challenges, and personal stories from women navigating various health topics. The site combines editorial journalism with interactive fitness programs and health education resources.

## Key Topics

- Women's Health
- Wellness & Lifestyle
- Mental Health
- Nutrition & Gut Health
- Fitness & Exercise
- Medical Conditions
- Menopause
- Sleep Wellness
- Relationships & Trauma
- Cardiovascular Health
- Health Education
- GLP-1 Medications
- Medical Advice

## Core Health & Wellness

- [Women's Health & Wellness Advice](https://www.self.com/health): Women's health & wellness advice covering mental health, nutrition, sleep, and relationships.
- [Women's Health Issues & Concerns from A-Z](https://www.self.com/health-conditions): A-Z health guide for identifying, treating, and preventing women's medical issues.

## Fitness & Video Content

- [Video](https://www.self.com/video): Fitness videos featuring celebrity workouts, workout series, and wellness content.
- [SELF Fitness Challenges](https://www.self.com/fitness/challenges): Fitness challenges including cardio, strength, and at-home workout programs.

## Stories & Features

- [5 Women on What It's Really Like to Be in Menopause Before 40](https://www.self.com/story/women-experiencing-menopause-before-40): Personal stories from women experiencing early or medically induced menopause.
- [How Azzi Fudd Became Basketball's Princess](https://www.self.com/story/azzi-fudd-cover-interview): Cover story interview with college basketball star Azzi Fudd headed to WNBA.

## Optional

- [Newsletters](https://www.self.com/newsletter): Email newsletter subscriptions for health, nutrition, and wellness content.
